Name: Waaagh!
Description:
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can:
- Re-roll advance rolls.
- Become riled up, as stated in other rules.
While a unit is riled up:
- That unit has 5+ InSv.
- That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
- When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Name: Kunnin’ Infiltrator
Description: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if each model in this unit is hidden and unengaged, you can place this unit in strategic reserves.

Name: Deff from the Shadows
Description: At the end of your opponent’s Movement phase, if this unit is in strategic reserves, this unit can make an ingress move.

Name: Da Boss
Description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

Name: Da Grand Warlord's Ladz
Description: While this unit is within 3" of another friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit, this unit has Lone Operative.

Name: Makari, Hoist Dat Banner!
Description: In your Movement phase, you can select a number of friendly ORKS units equal to or less than the current battle round number. Those units are riled up until the start of your next turn.

Name: Prophet of da Great Waaagh!
Description:
While a friendly ORKS unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit’s melee attacks have:
+1 to hit rolls.
+1 to wound rolls.

Name: Intimidating Motivation
Description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ORKS unit within 6" of this unit. That unit:
- Is no longer battle-shocked.
- Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Name: Nazdreg’s Know-wotz
Description:
- This unit has Deep Strike.
- This unit’s ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

Name: Supreme Kunnin’
Description:
In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can:
- Make a normal move of up to D6".
- Or: If this unit is riled up, make a normal move of up to 5".

Name: Super Runts
Description:
- This unit is riled up.
- This unit’s Scavenged Shivs weapons have +1 A, WS and S.

Name: One Last Kill
Description:
In the Fight phase, when this model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:

- On a 2+, do not remove this model from the battlefield. When this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this model is removed from the battlefield.

Name: Da Bigger Dey Iz…
Description: This unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll wound rolls.

Name: Beast Snagga Following
Description: While this unit is within 3" of a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit (excluding MONSTER CHARACTER units), this unit has Lone Operative.

Name: Full Throttle
Description:
In your Command phase, select one Throttlerokkit Shokka Engine ability (see above). This unit has that ability until the start of your next Command phase.

- Turbo Engine: When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

- Shokk Attack Engine: In your Command phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can place this unit in strategic reserves.

- Pulse Jet: In your Movement phase, when this unit is selected to move, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a pulse jet move.

Name: Waaagh! Banner
Description: This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

Name: Keep Huntin’!
Description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of this unit. That unit:
- Is no longer battle-shocked.
- Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Name: Dodge Dis!
Description: This unit’s attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

Name: More Dakka
Description:
This unit’s ranged attacks have:
- [Ignores Cover].
- If this unit is riled up, [Sustained Hits 1].

Name: Shokk-boosta
Description:
In your Movement phase, when this unit is selected to make an advance move, you can use this ability. If you do:
- This unit can change that advance roll to a 6.
- This unit can move through all types of model.
- When this unit ends that advance move, make a hazard roll for each model in this unit.

Name: Fix Dat Armour Up
Description: In your Command phase, this unit heals 3 wounds.

Name: More Dakka
Description:
This unit’s ranged attacks have:
- [Ignores Cover].
- If this unit is riled up, [Sustained Hits 1].

Name: Support Shokka
Description: While this model is within 3" of a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN units), this model has Lone Operative.
